CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content present.

COD.rationale: The report explicitly lists content (color coordinates), an origin/status entry, and spatial presentation information for the same p0/current/n1 referent.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition linked to the identified content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: Report explicitly identifies content items (color assignments) with coordinate lists for current and candidate entries.

D.rationale: Origin/status metadata is provided separately from the listed content, distinguishing identification from provenance/organization status.

O.rationale: The text specifies how content is presented (grid orientation and explicit coordinate patterns for colors).
